author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
"Country Nights"
Got the strangest phone call of my life last week
these things happen
after you spend the night aimlessly walking in the woods
howling to no avail into the wind
"Do you have a dog named Eddie"
"Yes did you find him"
"He was in my barn"
"Oh god did he kill all your animals?"
"No but he slept with my pig"
